title: Shipping policy
content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders above INR 999 receive free standard shipping.

title: Returns policy
content: Eligible unused items may be returned within 30 days in their original packaging.

title: Support privacy standard
content: Customers must use official public support channels. Individual employee contact details and personnel information are never disclosed.

title: Account security
content: Support agents may verify account ownership but must not share private account details in a public conversation.

title: Escalation policy
content: When approved evidence is unavailable, agents must state that the information cannot be verified and route the case for review.
